notice: Synthetic preview. Clinical care and external delivery remain unavailable.
verifiedContext: Practice and location verified for this session.

loading.title: Checking access
loading.body: Confirming your current account and practice.

signed-out.title: You are signed out
signed-out.body: Sign in to open your practice when the Doctor Suit connection is available.

denied.title: Access unavailable
denied.body: This destination is unavailable for your current account and practice.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: Reconnect to check access. Private records are not stored on this device.

error.title: Could not check access
error.body: Try again after checking your connection.

ready.title: Workspace ready
ready.body: Your current practice and location have been checked. Clinical actions remain unavailable.

auth.description: Use your synthetic Doctor Suit account.
auth.unknownEmail: No account was found for this email.
auth.emailUnavailable: Could not check this email. Try again.
auth.connectionRequired: A local synthetic Doctor Suit connection and secure session storage must be verified before entering credentials.
auth.recoveryDescription: Request a one-time email code, then enter it with your new password. Use synthetic addresses ending in .test only.
auth.invalid: Enter the code and matching passwords of at least 12 characters.
auth.accountDescription: Your current account has been verified. Select your practice and location before opening its records.

errors.unavailable: The connection could not be verified. Try again.
errors.credentials: Sign-in failed. Check the credentials and email confirmation.
errors.revocation-unconfirmed: Signed out on this device. Server session revocation could not be confirmed.

context.discardBody: Switching clears unsaved changes from the current practice and location.
context.chooseHelp: Select your doctor, practice and location from the workspace selector.
context.noScopes: No active practice and location grants are available for this account.

patients.title: Patients
patients.description: Synthetic administrative records within the doctor practice.
patients.notice: Synthetic data only. Names, contacts and birth dates are entered and unverified. Recording them creates no patient account and never merges people automatically.
patients.name: Entered name
patients.empty: No matching records in this practice.
patients.duplicateDescription: People may share a name, phone or email. Review these records before saving a separate record or correcting this one. No identities will be merged.
patients.duplicateAcknowledgement: I reviewed the similar records and confirm saving this record without merging.
patients.unverified: Entered, unverified information; this is neither identity proof nor a clinical record.
patients.denied: Choose a practice and location with patient-read permission.
patients.archiveDescription: Hide this record from the active directory while preserving its identity, relationship and administrative history. Referenced records remain intact.
patients.readError: Could not load records. Check your connection and retry.

patientProfile.title: Administrative patient profile
patientProfile.notice: Synthetic entered administrative data, unverified. It does not establish patient identity or clinician authority and is not a finding or diagnosis.
patientProfile.attachmentNotice: Uploaded, unreviewed files are shown as recorded, without medical interpretation. Current access is required for every view or download; no public links are issued.
patientProfile.denied: You do not have access to this content in the current context.
patientProfile.name: Filename
patientProfile.fileHelp: PDF, PNG or JPEG, up to 5 MiB. The server validates the file type and bytes.
patientProfile.archiveDescription: Archive this attachment? Previous versions, upload attribution and history remain preserved for currently authorized accounts.
patientProfile.unreviewed: Uploaded and unreviewed — no finding, clinical review or patient identity verification is implied.
patientProfile.network: The request could not be completed. You can retry.
patientProfile.unavailable: The private file service is unavailable. Saved metadata and history remain preserved.
patientProfile.invalid: Choose a valid PDF, PNG or JPEG file up to 5 MiB.
patientProfile.conflict: The record version changed. Refresh and review the current state before retrying.
patientProfile.devicePolicy: File previews and downloads are unavailable until the device custody policy is approved and verified.

clinical.title: Synthetic clinical workspace
clinical.description: Encounters, entered content and preserved versions for workflow testing.
clinical.notice: Synthetic data only. Qualified clinical approval is not recorded. A test attestation is not a professional signature and authorizes neither prescribing nor real-patient data.
clinical.unavailable: This workspace requires separate synthetic clinical fixture access. Administrative permissions do not grant it.
clinical.name: Entered name
clinical.due: Optional due instant, ISO format with timezone
clinical.syntheticIdentity: Enter every value explicitly. There are no recommendations, inferred doses or assumed licensed medicine source. Validation establishes structural consistency only.
clinical.template: Neutral synthetic template, revision 1. It is not an approved clinical template or specialty coverage.
clinical.privateNotes: Working notes and intake remain practice-private. Releasing an artifact grants no chart membership and sends no external message.
clinical.releaseNotice: Only a finalized synthetic version, its instructions and explicitly released results are available to an independently linked recipient, until expiry, withdrawal or supersession.
clinical.exportNotice: Export includes every encounter revision, amendment link, event and document provenance digest. Snapshot time and the last included event ID are recorded; identical retries retain that snapshot. Storage bytes are separate; export grants no erasure or retention-policy approval.

clinicalState.unknown: Save outcome is unknown. It will not be resent. Review and close the draft, then load the server revision before a new action.
clinicalState.conflict: The server revision changed. The draft is retained for review; content is not merged or overwritten automatically.
clinicalState.discardBody: Discard unsaved edits and load the current server revision. This does not acknowledge a previous request.

prescriptionReview.title: Confirm synthetic finalization
prescriptionReview.description: Confirm the reviewed synthetic version {version}. Professional signing and live prescribing remain unavailable.
prescriptionReview.stale: The record or access changed. Close this confirmation and review the current server version.
prescriptionReview.expired: This review expired. Close the confirmation and review the current draft again.
prescriptionReview.denied: Current access does not permit this synthetic action.
prescriptionReview.unknown: The outcome is unknown. Refresh the server record before another action; this request will not be replayed.
prescriptionReview.invalid: Check the entered fields and required note or reason. Clinical values will not be inferred.
